AdvancedSearchLight.name: Advanced Searchlight
AdvancedSearchLight.hint:
A cutting edge surveillance device designed to detect and deter escaping prisoners, utilizing facial recognition.
You must connect a CCTV Monitor to this object for it to work

BackupGenerator.name: Backup Generator
BackupGenerator.hint: Stores solar energy that will automatically power the electricity in the event of a power cut when connected to the prison's electricity cables. Backup Generators are limited to one per circuit.

Battery.name: Battery
Battery.hint: Stores the excess energy converted by Transformers for emergencies or to be used as an export, must be placed adjacent to a Transformer to function.

Bin.name: Bin
extra: The Compost Bin will turn food and plant waste along with other substances into Compost Fertilizer for free.

Capacitor.name: Capacitor
Capacitor.hint: Increases the amount of electricity generated when placed next to a power station.

Cctv.name: CCTV
Cctv.hint:
Keep an eye on your prison without the need for guards to be everywhere at once.
You must Connect a CCTV Monitor to this camera for it to work.
extra: CCTV Cameras allow us to monitor areas of the prison even when no Guards are in the area. A single CCTV Monitor allows one Guard to view 8 different CCTV Cameras. They're a no brainer!
We need to install CCTV Cameras.

CctvCamo.name: CCTV (Camouflaged)
CctvCamo.hint:
Keep an eye on your prison without the need for guards to be everywhere at once. This camera comes in camo-print.
You must Connect a CCTV Monitor to this camera for it to work.

CctvMonitor.name: CCTV Monitor
CctvMonitor.hint:
Designed to be built in a Security Room, and operated by a Guard. Monitors the CCTV cameras around your prison remotely.
Use the Connect tool to connect this monitor to your CCTV cameras.
Note: A maximum of eight cameras can be viewed at once. If you connect more than eight cameras, the monitor will cycle through them gradually, giving only partial coverage.
extra: CCTV Cameras allow us to monitor areas of the prison even when no Guards are in the area. A single CCTV Monitor allows one Guard to view 8 different CCTV Cameras. They're a no brainer!

CompostBin.name: Compost Bin
extra: The Compost Bin will turn food and plant waste along with other substances into Compost Fertilizer for free.

CompostFertilizer.name: Compost Fertilizer
extra: The Compost Bin will turn food and plant waste along with other substances into Compost Fertilizer for free.

DismantleUtility.name: Dismantle Utility
DismantleUtility.hint: Remove a utility object from your prison.

Door.name: Door
extra: Our guards currently have to spend most of their time opening jail doors for people, their time is too important for this! Install a Door Control system and one guard can open multiple doors remotely.
We should improve efficiency by installing a Door Control system.

DoorControlSystem.name: Door Control System
DoorControlSystem.hint:
Designed to be built in a Security Room, and operated by a Guard. Can be used to remotely open doors around your prison.
Use the Connect tool to connect this system to your Door Servos. The Door Servos should be built over the doors you wish to control remotely.
Note: You can connect this to as many Servos as you wish, however the Guard operating the system can open a maximum of two doors per second.
extra: Our guards currently have to spend most of their time opening jail doors for people, their time is too important for this! Install a Door Control system and one guard can open multiple doors remotely.
We should improve efficiency by installing a Door Control system.

DoorTimer.name: Door Timer
DoorTimer.hint:
Can be used to automatically open doors at certain times of day.
Use the Connect tool to connect this timer to your Door Servos.

Farmer.name: Farmer
extra: The Farmer will handle all jobs related to farming, they are also required to teach inmates how to also perform these jobs.

Fire.name: Fire
extra: A fire with a high wind could prove itself a catastrophe, make sure to prevent it and make preparations.
At the moment we are seriously unequipped to deal with a fire in the prison. We should install a sprinkler system as soon as possible.
We are at risk if a fire breaks out.

FoodBowl.name: Food
extra: Rooms related to growing, utilising, or storing food can be linked to each other, providing micro-management over ingredient distribution.
The Compost Bin will turn food and plant waste along with other substances into Compost Fertilizer for free.
Fruit Trees provide the most efficient food supply when grown in large quantities.

Garbage.name: Garbage
extra: Bins allow us to store lots of rubbish before they need emptying, this means much fewer trips to the garbage area. Add bins to the kitchen and place them near metal detectors to increase efficiency.

Guard.name: Guard
extra: CCTV Cameras allow us to monitor areas of the prison even when no Guards are in the area. A single CCTV Monitor allows one Guard to view 8 different CCTV Cameras. They're a no brainer!

Our guards currently have to spend most of their time opening jail doors for people, their time is too important for this! Install a Door Control system and one guard can open multiple doors remotely.
It's not safe for your guards to be so heavily outnumbered by the prisoners, each guard can safely manage around 5 prisoners.

HealthMonitor.name: Health Monitor
HealthMonitor.hint:
Required for the Tracking Menu.
Keeps track of your inmates health and status if they are equipped with a Tracking Belt. Install inside an infirmary.

HeavyDutyElectricalCable.name: Cable Protector
HeavyDutyElectricalCable.hint: Cables that distribute electricity around the prison will be resistant to damage from rats or sudden electrical surges with Cable Protectors installed on top of existing cabling

Ingredients.name: Ingredients
extra: Crop Distribution provides control over where prison-grown ingredients are moved after being harvested.

LogicBridge.name: Logic Bridge
LogicBridge.hint:
Advanced architects only.
Takes its incoming signal, and bridges it onto Electrical Cable installed in the same square. That Electrical cable will carry the signal to any other Logic Circuits installed on the same Electrical Cable.
Can be used to 'broadcast' a common signal all around your prison, eg Useful to pass around a common Clock signal.

LogicCircuit.name: Logic Circuit
LogicCircuit.hint:
Advanced architects only.
A simple circuit box that performs a logical operation based on its inputs, and sets its output accordingly.
Available operations: And / Or / Not / Nand / Nor / Xor
Right click to cycle through logical operations.

PhoneMonitor.name: Phone Tap
PhoneMonitor.hint:
Designed to be built in a Security Room and operated by a Guard. Allows you to monitor all outgoing phone calls made by inmates, giving you vital insights into planned illegal activity.
Use the Connect tool to connect this system to your Phone Booths.

PipeHotLagged.name: Pipe (Hot) Insulation
PipeHotLagged.hint: A layer of insulation protects hot water pipework from freezing as quickly in sub zero conditions.

PipeLarge.name: Large Pipe
PipeLarge.hint:
Distributes a large volume of water around your prison, under high pressure. Probably big enough for someone to crawl to freedom through five hundred yards of shit smelling foulness.
Please note: not generally used to connect to sinks, shower heads etc. - the pressure is too high. Use a small pipe for that.

PipeSmall.name: Small Pipe
PipeSmall.hint: Used to connect items like toilets, showers, sinks etc, to your large pipe network. The pressure is much lower, so there is a limited length that a small pipe can run for before the pressure becomes too low.

PipeSmallLagged.name: Pipe (Small) Insulation
PipeSmallLagged.hint: A layer of insulation protects pipework from freezing as quickly in sub zero conditions.

PipeValve.name: Pipe Valve
PipeValve.hint: Toggles the availability of water to any pipe connected to it.

PipeValveLagged.name: Pipe Valve Insulation
PipeValveLagged.hint: Keeps Valve functionality flowing freely during sub zero conditions.

Plant.name: Plant
extra: The Compost Bin will turn food and plant waste along with other substances into Compost Fertilizer for free.

PowerExportMeter.name: Power Export Meter
PowerExportMeter.hint: An object that allows you to send off any stored energy back to the grid for financial returns. Must be wired to a Transformer that has Batteries connected to function correctly.

PowerStation.name: Power Station
PowerStation.hint: Generates electricity to be used in your prison, can also be connected to a Transformer to export power.
extra: Certain objects need to be connected to a Power Station to work, use electrical cables to connect all objects with a flashing lightning bolt icon on them to a Power Station.
Our Power Station is seriously overloaded, add more capacitors to it or build a new one to share the load. Be careful though, Power Stations can't be connected together!
Your Power Station is overloaded.

PowerSwitch.name: Power Switch
PowerSwitch.hint:
Toggles the availability of electricity to any cable connected to it.
Right click to toggle on/off state.

PressurePad.name: Pressure Pad
PressurePad.hint: Sends a signal to connected objects whenever something is on top of the pad.

Prisoner.name: Prisoner
extra: A fresh and clean uniform can make a big difference to a prisoner's quality of life. A Laundry Service is essential to catering to your prisoners 'Clothing' need.
Farming rooms allow for the planting of vegetables, fruit trees, and Cereals each, these crops can be either sold as exports or used for prisoner meals.

PrisonerMail.name: Mail
extra: Prisoners can become angry if they are not allowed to communicate with their families. Build a Visitation Room, a Mail Room or Phone Booths to hold off the prison blues.

QuickConnect.name: Quick Connect
QuickConnect.hint: Quickly connects any surveillance or automation systems to their closest recipient item.

Radiator.name: Radiator
Radiator.hint: Place them around your prison, rooms will be nice and toasty.

RemoteDoor.name: Remote Door
RemoteDoor.hint: A strong metal door that cannot be opened with a key (Can only be opened remotely). Use this to prevent mass escape events when a prisoner has Jail Keys.

Router.name: Router
Router.hint:
Required for the Tracking Menu.
When connected to the Tracking Monitor this item tracks any equipped prisoners within their range. Range can be checked individually or via the Tracking Menu for full coverage.

ScannerMachine.name: Scanner Machine
ScannerMachine.hint: A machine for Delivery areas and Storage rooms, to scan wooden crates for contraband. Must be wired to a Scanner Monitor, for a guard to spot contraband. A guard's ability to spot contraband will depend on their tiredness.

ScannerMonitor.name: Scanner Monitor
ScannerMonitor.hint: A monitor for a guard to spot contraband, when wired to a Scanner Machine. A guard's ability to spot contraband will depend on their tiredness

Servo.name: Door Servo
Servo.hint:
Place a servo over a door you wish to control remotely. Ensure the motor gear is directly above the door.
Once installed, the door will be opened when the Servo itself is triggered - typically by a Door Control System, or a Door Timer.
Servos can be chained together, so that when the first one opens it will trigger the later ones.

ShowAllWires.name: Show Wires
ShowAllWires.hint: Show every connected wire in your prison.

SolarPanels.name: Solar Panels
SolarPanels.hint: An electricity generator that harnesses the power of the Sun! They can be connected to multiple green power sources, but their power must first flow through a Transformer before it can be used within your prison.

SolarWindHybrid.name: Solar Wind Hybrid
SolarWindHybrid.hint: An electricity generator that harnesses both the power of wind and the Sun! They can be connected to multiple green power sources, but their power must first flow through a Transformer before it can be used within your prison.

StatusLight.name: Status Light
StatusLight.hint: Lights up either red or green, depending on the signal it is receiving.

TrackingMonitor.name: Tracking Monitor
TrackingMonitor.hint:
Required for the Tracking Menu.
Operated by a Guard inside a Security room to monitor any prisoners wearing Tracking Belts. Connect to Routers to extend the viewing range.

Transformer.name: Transformer
Transformer.hint: Converts the electrical power generated by green energy sources into appliance-friendly energy, multiple energy sources can be connected but Transformers have an input limit of 5000 units of power. Electrical cables must be connected in the direction shown by the attached arrow images.
extra: Batteries can be charged by any power source connected to a Transformer, even Power Stations.
All Green Energy sources need to be connected to a Transformer before their energy can be used.
Transformer objects are needed for both using green energy and for charging batteries.

Tv.name: Tv
extra: Help break up the day to day monotony by giving your prisoners access to recreational items such as Pool Tables, Radios and TV's.

VideoCallBooth.name: Video Call Booth
VideoCallBooth.hint: Let your prisoners see their loved ones, even when they cannot visit.

WaterBoilerLagged.name: Water Boiler Insulation
WaterBoilerLagged.hint: Thermal insulation to withstand sub zero conditions. Apply to an existing Water Boiler to protect against future freezing.

WaterPumpStation.name: Water Pump Station
WaterPumpStation.hint: Provides a source of water to your prison.

WaterStationLagged.name: Water Pump Insulation
WaterStationLagged.hint: Thermal insulation to withstand sub zero conditions. Apply to an existing Water Pump Station to protect against future freezing.

WeatherMachine.name: Weather Machine
WeatherMachine.hint: The Weather Machine provides an advanced weather forecast. It will predict the duration, temperature, precipitation, wind speed and visibility conditions. Additionally, it will give a countdown for any worrying weather event that might be incoming.

WindTurbine.name: Wind Turbine
WindTurbine.hint: An electricity generator that harnesses the power of wind! They can be connected to multiple green power sources, but their power must first flow through a Transformer before it can be used within your prison.

Wire.name: Connect
Wire.hint: Connect your remote access systems together.
extra: Certain objects need to be connected to a Power Station to work, use electrical cables to connect all objects with a flashing lightning bolt icon on them to a Power Station.
Certain objects need to be connected to a water pump to work, use water pipes to connect all objects with a flashing water drop icon on them to a water pump.

Execution.name: Execution
extra: Adding a Death Row to the Prison is risky as the execution needs to be handled very carefully so we meet all of the legal requirements... But, we could make lot of money, so it may be worth the risk!

Exports.name: Exports
extra: Farming rooms allow for the planting of vegetables, fruit trees, and Cereals each, these crops can be either sold as exports or used for prisoner meals.

Forestry.name: Forestry
extra: This behaviour matches that of the Forestry.

Garbage.name: Garbage
extra: Bins allow us to store lots of rubbish before they need emptying, this means much fewer trips to the garbage area. Add bins to the kitchen and place them near metal detectors to increase efficiency.

Kitchen.name: Kitchen
extra: Bins allow us to store lots of rubbish before they need emptying, this means much fewer trips to the garbage area. Add bins to the kitchen and place them near metal detectors to increase efficiency.

Laundry.name: Laundry
extra: A fresh and clean uniform can make a big difference to a prisoner's quality of life. A Laundry Service is essential to catering to your prisoners 'Clothing' need.

Library.name: Library
extra: A reader lives a thousand lives before he dies, the man who never reads lives only one. Let your prisoners 'escape' into a good book by giving them access to a library.

MailRoom.name: Mail Room
extra: Prisoners can become angry if they are not allowed to communicate with their families. Build a Visitation Room, a Mail Room or Phone Booths to hold off the prison blues.

MedicalWard.name: Infirmary
extra: We can't treat anyone in the Infirmary unless you hire some Doctors. Doctors can use the infirmary to treat any injuries that occur to staff or prisoners.
We should hire doctors to work in our Infirmary.

PsychiatristOffice.name: Psychiatrist's Office
PsychiatristOffice.hint: Unlock and place additional objects in the Psychiatrist Office to improve treatment to criminally insane inmates.
extra: Item :
Psychiatrist Ability:
Upgrade the Psychiatrist's Office to improve their ability.

Security.name: Security
extra: Our Informant will not last long in here without our protection, I suggest changing their security level to 'Protective Custody' and moving them out of general population.

Shower.name: Shower
extra: Hygiene is important in every day life, in prison it's essential. Make sure your prisoners have plenty of time to catch a shower.

Staffroom.name: Staffroom
extra: Your staff can't work effectively if they are exhausted, build them a staffroom so that they can relax or hire more staff as cover to ease the burden on them.

Visitation.name: Visitation
extra: Prisoners can become angry if they are not allowed to communicate with their families. Build a Visitation Room, a Mail Room or Phone Booths to hold off the prison blues.
